breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the instruction to set the end slopes to zero for a simply supported beam is physically incorrect. The generated specification explicitly states this error and clarifies that the correct boundary conditions (zero deflection at the supports) will be used, which aligns with how the ground truth prompt corrected the problem by removing the erroneous instruction.
